title: A registered run whose stage isn't a recognised check stays pending with no notice, so its holder reads it as a missing record
outcome: A session whose registered run can't produce a verification record because a stage isn't a recognised check is told so, with the reason, and doesn't have to ask or rerun to find out.
acceptance: A registered --input commit run that ends with an unclassified stage surfaces that reason, naming the stage, to the holder's next turn, without creating a record or credit
A deterministic test covers a passing focused run through scripts/test-temp-root.mjs, showing either the surfaced reason or a record, according to the decision in the next criterion

It is decided and recorded whether the classifier should recognise cargo test run through scripts/test-temp-root.mjs. If it does, an unrecognised command under the same wrapper still can't be classified as a test
